definitions.explanation: Losing a lot of money, or wasting a lot of time or effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{大損|おおぞん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I lost a lot on stocks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦{売|う}ったら→売る：00906_uru⟧{大損|おおぞん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If I sell now, it'll be a big loss.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}って→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れて→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧しまい、⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧{大損|おおぞん}だった。
examples.english: I bought it thinking it was cheap, but it broke right away, so in the end I lost out badly.

notes:
{大|おお} (big) + ⟦{損|そん}→損：03325_son⟧ (loss). Colloquial.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {大損|おおぞん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to lose heavily
- {大損|おおぞん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to turn into a big loss
- 〜⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{大損|おおぞん}: you'll really miss out if you don't ~ (common in advertising)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {丸損|まるぞん}: a total loss, with nothing recovered
- ⟦{損失|そんしつ}→損失：04875_sonshitsu⟧: loss (formal, business)
- {大儲|おおもう}け: a big profit (the opposite)
